title: Small-Amplitude Solitary Waves for $f$-Plane Capillary-Gravity Flows with Arbitrary Vorticity
summary: We study small-amplitude solitary waves for two-dimensional capillary--gravity flows with arbitrary vorticity on the equatorial $f$-plane. The steady free-boundary problem is formulated as a reversible Hamiltonian spatial-dynamics system in which rotation enters through the speed-dependent effective gravity $g_*=g-2Ωc$. A center-manifold reduction reduces the local bifurcation problem to finite-dimensional Hamiltonian systems governed by the low-frequency spectrum of a Sturm--Liouville problem with an eigenvalue-dependent boundary condition.
